verdict.rationale: Okta offers an Integrator Free Plan explicitly for testing code/apps without touching production ('Test your code and apps... manage and automate Okta for employees and partners') and a dedicated XAA Dev Playground described as free, requiring no local setup or infrastructure to provision, letting developers explore Cross App Access end-to-end. These support sandbox-style testing separate from production, but neither is explicitly framed as a dedicated 'sandbox tenant' with guaranteed production-data isolation for general Okta admin/API testing (only XAA-specific). Missing for 10: explicit sandbox/tenant isolation documentation for general Okta APIs beyond XAA, independent/hands-on confirmation that test data never touches production.
